title: incident-bot: on-call diagnostics enrichment (SLO/runbook linking + quick actions)
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: on-call flows frequently need quick context about affected SLOs and the canonical runbooks for a signal. This PR extends incident-bot's diagnostics pipeline to surface SLO->runbook links, enrich on-call summary cards with quick actions (open runbook, trigger mitigation play, annotate incident), and improve ranking of candidate runbooks using an SLO-aware matching score. Motivation: reduce mean time to acknowledge and mean time to mitigate by giving responders higher-confidence, one-click remediation links. Changes: 1) add slo-runbook indexer that keeps a TTL-backed mapping from SLO id and symptom tags to runbook urls; 2) enrich diagnostics payload with top-3 runbook suggestions and a matching score; 3) add quick action buttons to Slack/Teams cards (open, annotate, trigger-autofix placeholder); 4) instrument telemetry (metrics: runbook_suggestion.present, runbook_clicks, suggestion_score_histogram) and add unit/integration tests; 5) small UX text tweaks and docs. Checklist: - [x] slo-runbook indexer implementation - [x] diagnostics enrichment and card rendering - [x] tests for ranking and unit coverage - [x] telemetry hooks + dashboards PR - [x] docs and runbook for operators - [x] manual smoke tested in staging with SRE team Links: Linear ENG-4123, runbook indexer design doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4123/oncall-diagnostics-slo-runbook-indexer. Note: this PR does not enable autofix by default; the trigger button is a no-op placeholder wired to an audit log entry and will be gated behind a feature flag in a follow-up PR.
